name: pipejob
description: Agentic, human-in-the-loop career research assistant built on the Claude API

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run setup:browser
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
